purpose: Teach: 飛行場/プロパティ/アダルト/宇宙船/エルサレム/ミュンヘン/インスタント/イタリアン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんを飛行場までお見送りに行きましょう
lines.en: Sho, let's go see your dad off at the airport.
lines.style: Warm, practical mother-tone. Opens with gentle authority. Unhurried pace. The voice of someone making an ordinary plan feel like a small adventure for a child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ホームページのプロパティって何のこと?
lines.style: Quiet, genuinely puzzled. Asks without shame — the natural curiosity of a six-year-old who's encountered a word he doesn't know. Direct eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、アダルト向けのチャンネルは見ちゃダメよ
lines.en: Sho, you shouldn't be looking at adult channels.
lines.style: Calm but firm. Not angry. The tone of a parent setting a boundary gently but without negotiation. Clear, steady delivery. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、宇宙船のプラモデル作ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I made a spaceship model!
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick attack on the opening word. Lifting tone at the end — seeking her recognition and delight. Small but genuine pride in his voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが、エルサレム旅行のお話してくれたわ
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa told me about his trip to Jerusalem.
lines.style: Thoughtful, drawing the child into something larger. Slow, measured pace. The voice of someone offering a story, inviting him to listen and wonder.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんがミュンヘンの試合の話してたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad was talking about the match in Munich.
lines.style: Quiet, observant — reporting something he overhead. Slight wondering tone. Not seeking approval, just sharing what stuck with him. Thoughtful delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママ、お夜食にインスタントスープ作ろうかしら
lines.en: Sho, shall I make some instant soup for a late snack?
lines.style: Gentle, offering. Warm but slightly distant — thinking aloud to herself as much as to him. Slow, tender pace. Ends with a soft rise, inviting but not pushing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとイタリアン食べたいな
lines.en: Mom, I want to eat Italian food with Dad!
lines.style: Eager, hopeful. Quick tempo. Reaches toward the want — not demanding, but animated. Small-boy enthusiasm without whining. Eyes bright.
